content.short: Unmarshal is a multi-chain DeFi data network providing parsable, structured blockchain data APIs for developers building on Mantle.
content.description: Unmarshal is a multi-chain data indexing and API platform that transforms raw blockchain data into developer-friendly, structured formats for building wallets, DeFi dashboards, NFT apps, and analytics tools. The platform supports Mantle Network and dozens of other blockchains, offering token balance APIs, transaction history, DeFi position data, NFT metadata, and notification services. Unmarshal's goal is to be the one-stop data source for cross-chain dApp development, eliminating the need for teams to build their own data pipelines.
content.meta: Unmarshal provides structured multi-chain blockchain data APIs for developers building on Mantle. Discover Unmarshal on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
